name: Iraq
shortSummary: Iraq is consistently among India's top crude oil suppliers, though the relationship remains largely transactional and centred on energy, with limited strategic or defence dimensions.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Iraq is consistently one of India's top two crude oil suppliers.

majorChallenges.title: Regional instability
majorChallenges.description: Periodic conflict and political instability in Iraq pose risks to Indian workers and energy contracts.

recentDevelopments.title: Iraq remains a top-two crude oil supplier
recentDevelopments.description: Iraq continued to be one of India's largest sources of crude oil imports, with the relationship remaining largely transactional and energy-focused.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Confirms the relationship's continued centrality to India's energy security, with limited broader strategic expansion.

historicalEvents.title: Post-War Diplomatic Re-engagement
historicalEvents.description: India re-establishes full diplomatic engagement with Iraq following the 2003 war, expanding energy trade over the following decade.

historicalEvents.title: Mosul Hostage Crisis
historicalEvents.description: ISIS forces capture 39 Indian construction workers in Mosul; India confirms their deaths in 2018 after a prolonged search and identification effort.

multilateralRelations.detail: India engages Iraq bilaterally as a major oil producer outside formal OPEC membership.
